selection: Full-candidate normalized AUC: observed days -> sampled future windows -> training cutoffs -> 30/45/60-day horizons, each level equal-weighted. No fixed Top-N cutoff.

sampling.startRule: round(i * (futureDays - horizon) / (windowCount - 1)) calendar days after the fixed training cutoff; i=0..windowCount-1, deduplicated

audit.previousExperiment: The 7-day/Top-1000 pilot and adjacent-only 30/45/60-day evaluation were superseded; outputs remain in ignored short-horizon/ and adjacent-windows/.
audit.candidateExtension: 1 and 3 days were added after the pilot’s 7-day lower boundary won. Data have been examined before; this is retrospective model comparison, not a blind holdout.
audit.dependence: Training histories are nested. Test windows overlap within and across cutoffs and horizons. Earlier/later groups refer to training cutoffs, share future observations, and are not independent validation sets.
